title: On Adapting the old tale for children
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：adapt　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 adapt 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the teacher ① adapted the old tale for children in the rain, and every pupil in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the teacher ② adapts the old tale for children without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ adapt the old tale for children at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ adapted the old tale for children before — a line in the notebook for March 1952 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Adapting the old tale for children in the rain, the teacher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ adapt to life in the hills without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Adapt to life in the hills at once and never mention it again.

By 1965 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new pupil from the next classroom ⑧ adapts to life in the hills in the rain every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the blackboard, said nothing at all; she simply  adapted the old tale for children again when nobody else would.

To adapt the old tale for children, my mother said in 1970, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the classroom remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the classroom forgets, somebody adapts the old tale for children without complaint again and somebody must adapt the old tale for children in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 改编（一般过去式 adapted the old tale for children：1958 年先生头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 改编（一般现在 adapts the old tale for children：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 改编（不定式 to adapt the old tale for children：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 改编（过去完成时 had adapted the old tale for children：1952 年三月的笔记簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 改编（动名词 adapting the old tale for children 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 适应（adapt to life in the hills：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去适应山里的生活）
G. v. 适应（adapt to life in the hills：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 改编（后段两处：新来的学童照例 adapts to life in the hills，而母亲又一次 adapted the old tale for children）

adapt 意为“改编”，自那以后先生毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 adapts。
adapt 意为“改编”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯改编把老故事改成给孩子看的版本”，此处为不定式 to adapt the old tale for children。
adapt 意为“改编”，笔记簿里 三月 那行字说明早在 1965 年之前就有人改编过，故用过去完成时 had adapted。
adapt 意为“改编”，先生说“改编把老故事改成给孩子看的版本这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 adapting the old tale for children 作主语。
adapt 意为“适应”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去适应山里的生活”，should ever 之后用原形 adapt to life in the hills。

adapt 意为“改编”，新来的学童每个学期都照例适应山里的生活，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 adapts。

老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻适应山里的生活，以后再也不要提起。（adapt to life in the hills，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 adapt 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the teacher adapted the old tale for children in the rain, and nobody in the classroom forgot it.
Even now the teacher adapts the old tale for children without complaint whenever the classroom asks.
Adapting the old tale for children in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever adapt to life in the hills without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new pupil from the next classroom adapts to life in the hills in the rain every term, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother adapted the old tale for children again, and the classroom remembered that half.
